'''Héctor Manuel Moya-Cessa''' (born 27 June 1966) is a [[physicist]] specialising in [[quantum optics]]. He is currently a researcher/lecturer at [[INAOE|Instituto Nacional de Astrofísica, Optica y Electrónica]], in [[Tonantzintla]], [[Puebla]], [[Mexico]].<ref name="Website-2">{{Cite web |title=Héctor Manuel Moya-Cessa |url=https://www-optica.inaoep.mx/~hmmc/ |access-date=2026-10-18 |website=www-optica.inaoep.mx}}</ref>

==Career==
Born in [[Acayucan]], [[Veracruz]], [[Mexico]], Moya-Cessa performed work on his [[PhD]] with [[Peter Knight (physicist)|Peter Knight]] at [[Imperial College]] (1990–1993).<ref>{{Cite thesis |last=Moya-Cessa |first=Hector Manuel |title=Non-classical states in light-matter interactions |date=1993 |publisher=Department of Physics, Imperial College}}</ref>

He served as President of the Division of Quantum Information of the [[:es:Sociedad_Mexicana_de_Física|Mexican Physical Society]] from 2011 to 2013.<ref name="Website-1">{{Cite web |last=redacción |first=Por |date=2022-01-11 |title=Otorgan a Héctor Moya Cessa la Medalla Marcos Moshinsky |url=https://www.cronica.com.mx//academia/otorgan-hector-moya-cessa-medalla-marcos-moshinsky.html |access-date=2026-10-18 |website=La Crónica de Hoy |language=es}}</ref>

== Research ==
He has published works on the generation of [[Nonclassical_light|non-classical states]] of the quantized electromagnetic<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Moya-Cessa |first1=Héctor |title=Decoherence in atom–field interactions: A treatment using superoperator techniques |journal=Physics Reports |date=September 2006 |volume=432 |issue=1 |pages=1–41 |doi=10.1016/j.physrep.2006.06.001 |bibcode=2006PhR...432....1M }}</ref> field and in trapped ions.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Moya-Cessa |first1=Héctor |last2=Soto-Eguibar |first2=Francisco |last3=Vargas-Martínez |first3=José M. |last4=Juárez-Amaro |first4=Raúl |last5=Zúñiga-Segundo |first5=Arturo |title=Ion–laser interactions: The most complete solution |journal=Physics Reports |date=April 2012 |volume=513 |issue=5 |pages=229–261 |doi=10.1016/j.physrep.2012.01.002 |arxiv=1210.8127 |bibcode=2012PhR...513..229M |s2cid=119273686 }}</ref> He has also studied analogies between classical and quantum systems in waveguide arrays and with coworkers has experimentally shown how to perform the [[discrete Fourier transform]] (DFT) in these types of systems.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Weimann |first1=Steffen |last2=Perez-Leija |first2=Armando |last3=Lebugle |first3=Maxime |last4=Keil |first4=Robert |last5=Tichy |first5=Malte |last6=Gräfe |first6=Markus |last7=Heilmann |first7=René |last8=Nolte |first8=Stefan |last9=Moya-Cessa |first9=Hector |last10=Weihs |first10=Gregor |last11=Christodoulides |first11=Demetrios N. |last12=Szameit |first12=Alexander |title=Implementation of quantum and classical discrete fractional Fourier transforms |journal=Nature Communications |date=23 March 2016 |volume=7 |issue=1 |article-number=11027 |doi=10.1038/ncomms11027  |doi-access=free|pmid=27006089 |pmc=4814576 |arxiv=1508.00033 |bibcode=2016NatCo...711027W }}</ref> Using this he and coworkers have shown that precisely the DFT of a number operator in an s-dimensional [[Hilbert space]] corresponds to the best definition of a phase operator<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Perez-Leija |first1=Armando |last2=Andrade-Morales |first2=Luis A |last3=Soto-Eguibar |first3=Francisco |last4=Szameit |first4=Alexander |last5=Moya-Cessa |first5=Héctor M |title=The Pegg–Barnett phase operator and the discrete Fourier transform |journal=Physica Scripta |date=1 April 2016 |volume=91 |issue=4 |article-number=043008 |doi=10.1088/0031-8949/91/4/043008 |arxiv=1512.07175 |bibcode=2016PhyS...91d3008P |s2cid=118343986 }}</ref> in quantum optics: the Pegg and Barnett <ref>{{cite journal |last1=Barnett |first1=S. M. |last2=Pegg |first2=D. T. |title=Quantum theory of rotation angles |journal=Physical Review A |date=April 1990 |volume=41 |page=3427 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevA.41.3427 }}</ref> phase operator.

In [[classical optics|Optics]] he has shown that the [[Quantum_potential|Bohm potential]] can be used to explain the [[Gouy phase]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Moya-Cessa |first1=Héctor M. |last2=Hojman |first2=Sergio A. |last3=Asenjo |first3=Felipe A. |last4=Soto-Eguibar |first4=Francisco |title=Bohm approach to the Gouy phase shift |journal=Optik |date=February 2022 |volume=252 |article-number=168468 |doi=10.1016/j.ijleo.2021.168468 |arxiv=2109.12373 |s2cid=237941172 }}</ref> He has also shown that a GRIN medium, when studied beyond the paraxial approximation, generates an analogy with a quantum [[Kerr_effect|Kerr medium]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Soto-Eguibar |first1=F. |last2=Arrizon |first2=V. |last3=Zúñiga-Segundo |first3=A. |last4=Moya-Cessa |first4=H. M. |title=Optical realization of quantum Kerr medium dynamics |journal=Optics Letters |date=1 November 2014 |volume=39 |issue=21 |pages=6158–6161 |doi=10.1364/OL.39.006158 |pmid=25361303 |arxiv=1406.2959 |bibcode=2014OptL...39.6158S }}</ref> By being able to generate non-classical states such as [[Schrödinger's cat]]s (superposition of [[coherent states]]), the separation of a [[Gaussian beam]] can be generated in this way without the use of [[Beam_splitter|beam splitters]].

== Awards ==
He is a Fellow of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Einzelansicht |url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/bewerben/foerderprogramme/feodor-lynen-forschungsstipendium/gastgebersuche/einzelansicht/1116095/prof-dr-hector-manuel-moya-cessa |access-date=2026-10-18 |website=www.humboldt-foundation.de |language=de}}</ref> and  the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Website-2" /> He has been awarded the [[International Commission for Optics|ICO]]-[[ICTP]] Prize<ref>{{Cite web |title=ICO/ICTP Winner 2006 {{!}} ICTP |url=https://www.ictp.it/home/icoictp-winner-2006 |access-date=2026-10-18 |website=www.ictp.it}}</ref> and a Science Research Prize of the  [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]] for those under 40,<ref name="Website-1">{{Cite web |last=redacción |first=Por |date=2022-01-11 |title=Otorgan a Héctor Moya Cessa la Medalla Marcos Moshinsky |url=https://www.cronica.com.mx//academia/otorgan-hector-moya-cessa-medalla-marcos-moshinsky.html |access-date=2026-10-18 |website=La Crónica de Hoy |language=es}}</ref> both in 2006. In 2021, he was awarded the [[:es:Medalla Marcos Moshinsky|Marcos Moshinsky Medal]] by [[UNAM]]'s Instituto de Física.<ref name="Website-1" />
